Security-relevant credential path + external tables — good multi-lens (security/api_contracts) eval.

Keep open for repeated Luffy runs.

commits.messageBody:
issue: #45881

Cross-tenant Azure external tables need broker-issued SAS credentials.
Milvus previously rejected the broker fields and could not pass them to
milvus-storage, so reads could not establish storage credentials.

Accept and forward the Azure client, tenant, and broker endpoint fields.
Require a complete Azure-only credential mode with an HTTP(S) endpoint,
and reject noncanonical cloud_provider casing before the original spec
reaches C++.

Pin the matching milvus-storage implementation while its upstream PR is
under review.

Validation:
- git diff --check
- gofmt -d on changed Go files
- Full check-commit was not run for this exact candidate; unavailable.

Signed-off-by: Wei Liu <wei.liu@zilliz.com>
commits.messageHeadline: enhance: support Azure credential broker for external tables

commits.messageBody:
issue: #45881

The Azure credential broker implementation has been merged into the
official milvus-storage repository. Keeping the temporary fork and PR
head would leave Milvus pinned to a review-only source after upstream
integration completed.

Pin the dependency to the immutable squash-merge commit on the official
repository so builds consume the canonical implementation.

Validation:
- git diff --check
- Verified upstream milvus-storage main resolves to the pinned commit.
- Build and tests were not run for this dependency-only candidate.

Signed-off-by: Wei Liu <wei.liu@zilliz.com>
commits.messageHeadline: chore: use merged milvus-storage Azure broker revision

commits.messageBody:
issue: #45881

The G101 heuristic treats the Azure credential endpoint key and the
synthetic storage account name as hardcoded credentials. Code-check
therefore fails even though neither literal is a deployable secret.

Annotate only those two declarations as known false positives. Runtime
validation, persisted JSON, and external-storage wire keys remain
unchanged.

Validation:
- git diff --check
- gofmt -d on the two changed Go files
- golangci-lint v2.11.3 on pkg/util/externalspec/...
  with GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.5 and dynamic,test build tags

Signed-off-by: Wei Liu <wei.liu@zilliz.com>
commits.messageHeadline: fix: mark Azure broker literals as non-secret

title: luffy-eval: #51995 Azure credential broker for external tables
